note: Each example is one point blowup: z^q + F with F clean, the divisor, the chart and the translations. Check it with: sing lab step -p P -q Q -vars VARS -f F -divisor DIVISOR -chart CHART -t VAR=VALUE. The polynomials are up to a unit factor that is a q-th power, which does not change the invariants (see the README of lab/).
